about: Sainte-Julienne is a municipality in Lanaudière, Quebec, in the lower Laurentians north of Montréal toward Rawdon—not a large city. Forest lakes, residential growth, and cottage-country roads define this expanding Montréal exurb. About 11,000 people live in Sainte-Julienne.
